name: Measured brushwork
description: Pigment-aware strokes stop at color boundaries; finer brushes repair lost forms.

name: Broken color
description: Longer, narrower painted passages with irregular dry tips.

name: Loaded brush
description: Fuller paint deposits with stronger bristle relief.

name: Loaded fibers
description: Individual bristles form pressure-shaped paint deposits, with filtered relief that stays quiet at small scales.

name: Impasto fibers
description: Stronger directional light across loaded paint and irregular bristle tips.

name: Layered oil
description: A broad bristled underpainting, finished with fine full-resolution marks.

name: Coherent accents
description: Bristled underpainting with compact pigment marks for people and narrow strokes for edges.

name: Confident passages
description: Opaque bristled passages follow the architecture, with compact finishing marks.

name: Quiet impasto
description: Fuller middle brushes and restrained accents leave room for the broad paint.

name: Selective brushwork
description: Small accents follow real source features, allowing the broad paint surface to remain visible.

name: Settled pigment
description: Source-led accents and orientation-neutral bristles keep paint from flipping as edges move.

name: Loaded pigment
description: Fuller deposits carry two nearby source pigments, with stronger light across the bristles.

name: Quiet hand
description: The calmer underpainting, with selective small forms and stable bristle lighting.

name: Quiet loaded paint
description: Stable source-led detail over fuller, softly lit pigment deposits.

name: Form-led oil
description: Large loaded brushes stop at each form in both directions; compact accents retain the people.
